Air cargo service providers at Kaunas Airport (KUN)

A SYNTHETIC directory page for tests: every company, person and address below is invented.

  • Nemunas Cargo Services UAB is a cargo GSSA based at Kaunas Airport (KUN). Contact: cargo@nemunascargo.example.

  • Baltic Ticket Centre UAB is the GSA for passenger ticket sales of Amber Example Air in Lithuania. Contact: tickets@balticticket.example.

  • Amber Example Air is a passenger airline operating from Kaunas Airport (KUN) and carrying belly cargo on its flights to Oslo (OSL).

  • Vilnius Freight Hub UAB is a freight forwarder with offices in Vilnius and Kaunas.
